caption: The drawing features two black line illustrations of a long-sleeved coat on a light beige background. The illustration on the left shows the coat from a three-quarters side view, displaying details such as the collared neckline, the front buttons, the pocket with a flap on the lower side, the seam lines running vertically along the sleeve and body, a turned-up cuff, and a split at the back hem secured with buttons. The illustration on the right shows the coat from the rear, revealing symmetrical seam lines running vertically from the shoulders down to the back hem, a turned-up cuff on each sleeve, a collared neckline, two rectangular pocket flaps at the hip level, and two split sections at the lower back hem each secured with a button. Both views are constructed with clean, clear black lines and contain no color filling or shading apart from the beige background.
title: Boy's Cutaway Jacket
